title: CLMS VLCC Tree Cover Density Confidence Layer (TCDCL) Europe 10m yearly V1 (COG)
description: The High Resolution Tree Cover Density Confidence Layer (TCDCL dataset provides a quality support raster product. This dataset is provided annually starting with 2018 in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries. High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs).
